spanish: Por cuanto aconsejó sobre ti Aram mal, Efráyim e hijo de Remalyahu, diciendo:

findings.issue: misplaces and syntactically misconnects Aram + Ephraim + ben-Remalyahu; Spanish order and punctuation after 'sobre ti' do not license the Hebrew subject-apposition structure
findings.spanishSpan: Aram mal, Efráyim e hijo de Remalyahu

notes: word order and participant roles altered
